findings.F1_the_three_trivial_rails_are_a_stale_s: the cells carry their rail-instantiate write timestamp, not a later run's, and the unaccounted count is the county's whole parcel_record population: the derivation pass that writes them had run for Hays only. This is the dispatch's 'why it never ran or never wrote for the other five'. The writer itself was never missing -- parcel-record-fill's own derived pass (deriveSitusStateOntoRecords / deriveAcreageSqftOntoRecords / deriveLandUseVintageOntoRecords, all OPS-21 D1) writes all three, and it runs inside the same county-wide path as the CAD ingest.
findings.F2_situsState_had_a_real_defect_behind_t: the D1 implementation is `rec.countyFips.startsWith('48') ? 'TX' : nothing` with source 'derived-county-fips' -- a constant, not a derivation. Hays carries 62k values written that way, so Hays 'passes' the rail on values no parcel's own situs ever backed. The dispatch forbids exactly this: 'situsState is only TX when the parcel's own situs or geometry says so'.
findings.F3_citationUrl_is_empty_because_its_writ: measured on the same rows: citationUrl's cells were last written at rail instantiate while zoningDistrict / zoningProvenance on those rows were rewritten 2026-09-08/09 by the last parcel-r5-zoning run; OPS-21 D1 added citationUrl as a fourth rail on 2026-09-10. So the rail's emptiness is a stale store awaiting the integration seat's re-run, not an acquisition gap -- which is why the 'excluded-no-acquisition-path' label is wrong in substance: classifyExclusion defaults any declared-ahead rail with zero earned cells program-wide to that class, and the class names a finding the evidence does not support.

Measured at the same time: tx_zoning_district_staging holds zero null/blank source_urls (339,183 rows), so in the live data the branch would not fire today -- the fix is that it cannot fire into a fabricated citation when a future staged layer arrives without one.
findings.F4_the_companion_gap_is_real_but_much_na: grouping the unaccounted acreageMethod / landUseSource cells by their PRIMARY's own basis in the store: the join-miss signature (basis.source='cad_property' with no taxYear, which only the engine's applyCadJoinMiss path can emit) accounts for Hays's cohort, measured at acreageMethod 433 and landUseSource 636 cells. Every unaccounted companion in the other five counties carries a taxYear-bearing matched-row basis -- a write from BEFORE the dfdf6fd engine re-vendor (2026-09-05) that stamped a companion absent-verified only on the matched-row path, and which a replay of the current code resolves. D1_situsState_becomes_an_evidence_ladder.whyNotDeriveFromTheCountyAlone: that is the defect. A county is not a parcel: the rail asserts the state of THIS parcel's situs, and the only honest sources are the parcel's own situs fields and its own geometry record.
D1_situsState_becomes_an_evidence_ladder.whyNoWriteIsAllowed: the dispatch says 'never a value where the source is silent'. The alternative to a value is not a fabricated one -- it is an absence, reported. The run record carries moved / out-of-state / silent counts plus bounded samples.
D1_situsState_becomes_an_evidence_ladder.whyTheGeometryRungIsNotAFabrication: the dispatch's own words are 'the parcel's own situs or geometry says so'. The geometry is the parcel's own polygon record, and the rung additionally requires the parcel's county boundary record to name Texas, so a boundary row that ever changed would move the rail with the data instead of a constant in this file.
D1_situsState_becomes_an_evidence_ladder.whyTheZIPRungIsNotOutOfStateEvidenceInRe: a non-Texas 5-digit zip is NOT treated as evidence of out-of-state (CAD zips are one dialed field; the earlier census measured stray Michigan/Virginia values and typos). Only an address state token is decisive against Texas. Failing closed on the Texas assertion while failing open on silence is the direction that cannot fabricate.

D2_theOutOfStatePopulationIsCountedNotWr.decision: an address token naming another state leaves the cell untouched (no value, no not-applicable, no refused).
D2_theOutOfStatePopulationIsCountedNotWr.why: the honest cell state for 'this parcel's own situs says it is not Texas' on a Texas-assertion rail is a decision the operator may want to make (refused-with-basis vs not-applicable vs an out-of-state program), and inventing one here would be a policy this lane was not given. The count and samples make it rulable.
D2_theOutOfStatePopulationIsCountedNotWr.consequenceForTheGrade: the rail stays short of a full pass in counties where such parcels exist. Predicted counts come from the dry runs; the residual is named, not hidden.

D3_companionCompletionReadsTheEnginesOwn.decision: completeJoinMissCompanionsOntoRecords fires only when the primary cell is absent-verified AND its basis is source='cad_property' with taxYear === undefined AND it carries a vintage and a propId.
D3_companionCompletionReadsTheEnginesOwn.why: a matched row's basis always carries taxYear (cadNullVerified refuses to emit without one), so the predicate is the engine's own distinction between 'the roll says nothing' and 'this node is not in the roll'. Re-deriving that from a count, a second query, or a property of my own invention would be a second implementation of the engine's decision (the CTRL-1 shape).
D3_companionCompletionReadsTheEnginesOwn.whatItDeliberatelyDoesNotDo: it does not touch a rail whose primary is unaccounted, does not overwrite an earned companion, does not write a value, and never writes the companion for a matched-row null (which already carries it).

D4_theEngineSideGapIsNamedNotAbsorbed.decision: the job-level completion is the fix for the six counties; the vendored engine is NOT edited (ENGINE_PIN.json forbids it and test/engine-pin-divergence.test.mjs pins the divergence to the P-252 fixture only).
D4_theEngineSideGapIsNamedNotAbsorbed.why: the engine's join-miss branch stamping 13 scalars and not their two companions is the upstream defect; a repair that lives only in this job leaves the next consumer of the engine with the same gap. Filed as an OPEN thread with the exact file and function in the close.

D5_theCitationRailsSayAbsentVerifiedInst.decision: citationCellState returns value only for a non-blank source_url; otherwise absent-verified with a basis naming the matched staging row, city, district and vintage.
D5_theCitationRailsSayAbsentVerifiedInst.why: {kind:'value', value:null} is the shape that claims a citation that does not exist -- the dispatch's 'where no citation exists the cell says so, it is not left unaccounted'. The basis has to name the matched row, or a reader cannot tell 'the row has no url' from 'the polygon never matched' (the second is a gap this job must not paper over).
D5_theCitationRailsSayAbsentVerifiedInst.scopeLimit: this changes exactly two rails, on the matched-parcel path, with a test that asserts this module constructs exactly one absent-verified kind in exactly one place.

D6_acreageSqft_and_landUseVintage_get_no.decision: the other two trivial rails are left alone; their fix is the integration seat's re-run, which this lane predicts.
D6_acreageSqft_and_landUseVintage_get_no.why: their writers exist, are correct, are exercised by tests, and the store evidence says they never wrote for five counties. Adding code for a rail whose writer is not broken would be movement without a measurement.

D7_theNotAStateBlocklistHoldsOnlyFireabl.decision: the blocklist is {CT, FL} and a test asserts every member is a USPS code.
D7_theNotAStateBlocklistHoldsOnlyFireabl.why: addressStateToken consults the blocklist only after checking the token IS a state code, so an entry that is not a code (ST, LN, RD) can never fire -- it is decoration, and DEV_PROCESS refuses guardrails that cannot fire. The test asserts the invariant directly, so dead entries cannot accumulate again.

servePathConsequence_A193_statedBecauseT.theRule: OPS-24 law 7 / A-193: until P-297 is live the serve path switches on the county verdict, so ANY write that puts an unaccounted cell on a slated rail turns that whole county's ledger values back to the bake.
servePathConsequence_A193_statedBecauseT.doesThisLaneIntroduceThatShape: no. Every cell this lane leaves unaccounted is a cell that is unaccounted in the store TODAY (the three trivial rails are full-county unaccounted in five counties; the companions are unaccounted in the counts tabled above). What changes is that the population shrinks and the reason becomes visible. Specifically: (a) the completion step only ever turns unaccounted -> absent-verified; (b) the citation rails only ever turn unaccounted/unwritten -> value or absent-verified on the MATCHED-population path; (c) the situsState ladder turns unaccounted -> value where evidence exists and leaves unaccounted alone where it does not; (d) UPSERT_CELLS_BATCH_SQL's existing guard means an incoming unaccounted can never downgrade a stored non-unaccounted cell, so a re-run cannot take an earned Hays cell backwards.
servePathConsequence_A193_statedBecauseT.whatTheIntegrationSeatShouldKnow: for five counties the three rails will still be short of a pass after the apply (the silent/out-of-state residue), so those counties remain in the pre-P-297 state for those rails -- the same state they are in now, at a much smaller count. This is stated so the applies are not read as 'the county now passes'.

howThisChangeCouldBeWrongAndStillPassIts: The ladder could be tested only through resolveSitusStateEvidence's pure function while the wiring in fillCountyWide passes the wrong propIds (or an empty set for every page) -- the rails would then silently stay unaccounted and every unit test would still pass. Closed by an end-to-end instantiateAndIngest test that asserts the geometry facts are threaded from the page into the ladder, and by the dry run's own moved/silent counts, which are non-zero only if the wiring is live.

The out-of-state branch could be unreachable (a token that never parses) and the tests would still pass on the silent branch's counts. Closed by a test that asserts addressStateToken('100 OAK ST, MEMPHIS, TN 38103') is 'TN' and that a parcel with that address resolves outcome out-of-state with NO write, and by the census being reported per outcome.

The completion step could fire on matched-row nulls (writing a companion that a different basis already owns) if the predicate were loosened. Closed by a test asserting a matched-row basis (taxYear present) does NOT complete, and by isCadJoinMissBasis refusing a basis with no propId/vintage.

The citation change could be silenced by only ever seeing non-null source_urls in fixtures, leaving the absent-verified branch unpinned. Closed by a test that drives buildZoningCells with source_url null, with a blank string, and with a real URL, asserting value/absent-verified/absent-verified respectively.

The whole change could be a no-op against the live store (e.g. the derived pass requires a cohort that never appears in the six counties) and the dry runs are the only thing that would reveal it. That is exactly why falsifier 1 is registered below as a per-county dry run, and why no 'closed' status will be claimed without it.
